purpose: Teach: モットー/貸与/累計/問屋/立ち寄り/小売り/衣料/言明

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、市民安全のモットーを掲げております
lines.en: Our department upholds the principle of public safety.
lines.style: Professional, measured opening. Clear enunciation on 'principle.' Steady eye contact. Formal but not rigid — the tone of someone stating organizational policy with quiet conviction.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、機材を市民に貸与なさるんですね
lines.en: Yes, so the police provide equipment loans to citizens.
lines.style: Attentive and respectful. Light nod in the voice. Confirming what he's heard with genuine interest — not just going through motions. Slightly deferential register.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、累計検挙数の統計を作成しました
lines.style: Matter-of-fact delivery. Even pace. Slight emphasis on 'compiled' — the work is done, documentation is complete. No flourish, just factual.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、問屋からの不正流通を捜査されてますね
lines.en: I see — so you're investigating illegal distribution channels through wholesale networks.
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before speaking. Steady, demonstrating he's following the logic. Warm enough to show understanding, formal enough to respect the seriousness of the investigation.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、防犯のため店舗に立ち寄りで巡回します
lines.en: To prevent crime, we conduct regular foot patrols at retail locations.
lines.style: Methodical explanation. Even pace with slight emphasis on 'regular' — indicating consistent effort. Professional, unburdened. The tone of someone describing routine protective measures.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、小売り店の防犯指導もなさいますね
lines.en: Right — and you provide crime prevention guidance to shop owners as well.
lines.style: Appreciative acknowledgment. Warm undertone recognizing the breadth of work. Slightly slower pace — taking in the fuller picture of community protection.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、衣料品の偽造事件を捜査しております
lines.en: We're currently investigating counterfeit clothing operations.
lines.style: Steady, serious. Slight weight on 'counterfeit' — flagging the specific nature of the case. Professional gravity without theatricality. Composed delivery.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、市民への安全を改めて言明されましたね
lines.en: So you've reaffirmed your commitment to citizen safety across all these areas.
lines.style: Genuine warmth entering his voice for the first time. Slower cadence, almost reflective. Recognition of the scope of work. A moment of real connection after the procedural exchange.
